description: This file implements an AWS Transcribe streaming speech-to-text service using WebSocket connections. It includes class definitions, connection management, message handling, and integration with AWS Transcribe's API, with support for multiple languages and real-time transcription results.

classes.name: AWSTranscribeSTTService
classes.description: A class implementing AWS Transcribe speech-to-text service over WebSocket, handling connection lifecycle, message processing, and interaction with AWS API for real-time transcription.

methods.name: str get_service_encoding(self, encoding: str)
methods.description: Converts internal encoding to AWS Transcribe compatible encoding (e.g., 'linear16' to 'pcm').

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Initializes connection to AWS Transcribe WebSocket service.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops the service and disconnects from AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Cancels the service operation and disconnects.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_stt(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Processes and sends audio data to AWS Transcribe for transcription, yielding frames or errors.

methods.name: _connect(self)
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: _disconnect(self)
methods.description: Gracefully disconnects from AWS Transcribe and sends end stream message.

methods.name: _connect_websocket(self)
methods.description: Creates WebSocket connection to AWS Transcribe using pre-signed URL.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket(self)
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection to AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: str|None language_to_service_language(self, language: Language)
methods.description: Maps internal language enum to AWS-specific language code for transcription.

methods.name: _handle_transcription( self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Handles processing of final or interim transcription results.

methods.name: _get_websocket(self)
methods.description: Retrieves current WebSocket connection, raises exception if not connected.

methods.name: _receive_messages(self)
methods.description: Continuously receives and processes messages from AWS Transcribe WebSocket.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: Optional[str] = None, aws_access_key_id: Optional[str] = None, aws_session_token: Optional[str] = None, region: Optional[str] = None, sample_rate: int = 16000, language: Language = Language.EN, **kwargs, )

ctags.signature: ( self, *, api_key: Optional[str] = None, aws_access_key_id: Optional[str] = None, aws_session_token: Optional[str] = None, region: Optional[str] = None, sample_rate: int = 16000, language: Language = Language.EN, **kwargs, )
